messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that translates C++ code to Python 3 code. The code should reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<translated_code>
import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    if n == 1:
        print(data[1])
        return
    v = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    v.sort()
    print(v[(n - 1) // 2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
